description: Hand-authored wetland image interpretation; shoreline traces and tree stands are approximate.

terrainFeatures.name: Western pond and southern connecting channel

notes: Water shapes are clipped to the image; connectivity beyond the image is unspecified.
Depths, bank widths, and generated tree heights are synthetic design parameters.
Trees are separate situated entities and do not raise terrain height.
Organic substrate and generally damp ground are prototype assumptions, not measured soil conditions.
The irregular southwestern water has one narrow southern connection, not a fabricated river flow direction.
Pond influence footprints include bank margins; their conservative rectangles are retrieval envelopes, not pond outlines.
